The 2014 provincial plan's Table 5 has a row that OCRs as '宣丰一铜鼓→彦水 110' — '宣丰' is plausibly an OCR misread of '宜丰' (Yifeng) given the visual similarity of 宣/宜, which would make this 'Yifeng-Tonggu, 110km', matching P4792's endpoints exactly. But the same table row carries an unexplained '→彦水' fragment and other rows in this table contain outright nonsensical place names (confirmed OCR corruption elsewhere in the document), so I am not confident enough in this single ambiguous digit/character read to stage it as a confirming ref. Declined rather than staged on shaky OCR — left UNRESOLVED. A cleaner re-extraction of this specific PDF (or a non-OCR source for this branch) would very likely close this unit; worth a follow-up pass.
